name: Hume Bank

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate home loan
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Stated on the product page as "95% maximum loan-to-value ratio (incl. LMI)", and corroborated by the published rate tier "myBlue Variable Rate 90.01% <=95% LVR". Page carries no publication date; as-at is the date it was read.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate home loan
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: Not stated as a policy maximum. Inferred from the published investor rate tiers, which stop at "myBlue Investor Variable Rate 80.01% <=90% LVR" while the owner-occupier tiers continue to 95%.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate home loan
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: Inferred from the rate-tier structure (60%, 60.01-80%, 80.01-90%, 90.01-95%) and the product page's statement that the 95% ceiling is "incl. LMI". Hume does not publish an explicit no-LMI ceiling.

notes.value: Published owner-occupier LVR rate tiers: <=60%, 60.01-80%, 80.01-90%, 90.01-95%. Investor tiers: <=60%, 60.01-80%, 80.01-90%. The nextBlue bridging loan variable rate is available across all LVRs up to 80%.
notes.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate home loan

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate home loan
maxLoanTermYears.note: "30 year maximum loan term", repeated for the liteBlue variable, myBlue fixed and myBlue variable owner-occupied products.

bridgingAvailable.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — Target Market Determinations index (nextBlue Bridging Loan TMD, October 2025)
bridgingAvailable.note: nextBlue Bridging Loan is a listed product with its own TMD dated October 2025.

smsfLendingAvailable.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — Target Market Determinations index (Self-managed super fund loan account TMD)
smsfLendingAvailable.note: A 'Self-managed super fund loan account' TMD is published; the TMD itself was not read in this pass, so terms are unknown.

notes.value: Broker distribution is confirmed by the product TMD: a distributor may engage in retail product distribution conduct through "In person communications (including in branch, through mobile lenders and through broker and referrer networks)", the issuer's and other approved third-party digital platforms, and other approved channels. Brokers seeking accreditation are directed to email accreditation@humebank.com.au; the broker portal itself (humebank.com.au/broker-portal-login) is behind a login.
notes.sourceTitle: Hume Bank — myBlue Variable Rate Home Loan Account TMD, effective 2 December 2024, s3 Distribution of the product

gaps: Hume Bank's broker portal is entirely behind a login; no public credit policy guide or broker lending guide exists.
The TMDs state only 'Standard lending criteria applies' for eligibility — no servicing buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis or credit-card assessment rate is published.
No published minimum or maximum loan amount.
No published income, employment tenure, credit history, security or residency policy.
Maximum LVR without LMI and maximum investment LVR are inferred from the published rate tiers rather than stated.
SMSF and bridging loan TMDs exist but were not read; their LVR and loan-size terms are unknown.
